title: Harness proposals ledger line
description: One event in the append-only harness proposals ledger at memory/proposals.jsonl. A proposal is a suggested change to the harness itself (a script, skill, template, schema, doc or policy) raised while a run was being worked. Every line is an event against a proposal id; the proposal's current status is its newest event. Lines are never rewritten. The contract is docs/learning-log.md; the gate is scripts/proposals.sh lint.

id.description: Proposal id, P-<YYYYMMDD>-<4 hex>, minted by scripts/proposals.sh add. Stable across every event for the same proposal.

event.description: Closed vocabulary. proposed opens; approved and rejected are the operator's weekly decision; merged folds a duplicate into another id; carded names the stage card the change became; landed names the commit that closed it; dismissed opens and closes in one event, recording a verifier HARNESS: line judged to be outside the harness so scripts/proposals.sh unlifted stops listing it. Legal transitions are enforced by scripts/proposals.sh, not by this schema.

agent.description: Canonical agent identity in git author form, e.g. 'Claude Fable 5.1 <claude-fable-5-1@local>'. The operator's own decision is recorded under the identity of the chat that recorded it; the note names the operator.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the event.

title.description: proposed only. One line, under about 80 characters, naming the change rather than the symptom.

kind.description: proposed only. What sort of harness surface the change touches. policy covers caps, gates, allowances and anything else that needs an explicit operator yes under the recovery policy.

target.description: proposed only. Repo-relative paths in the autometta checkout the change would edit. At least one; never an absolute path.

change.description: proposed only. What to change and why, in a few sentences. Enough for a weekly reviewer who did not see the run to decide; the card is written later.

evidence.description: proposed and dismissed only. References a reviewer can open: stage ids, escalation ids, memory/facts.jsonl subjects, repo-relative paths with optional #anchor, commit SHAs. At least one. A proposal with no evidence is an opinion. A citation of state/verifiers/<file>.json under the same repo marks that artefact's HARNESS: lines as lifted.

repo.description: Basename of the subscriber repo the observation came from, when it is not autometta itself. Required on dismissed.

stage_id.description: Optional on proposed; required on carded, where it names the card the proposal became.

run_id.description: Optional. The run during which the observation was made.

note.description: Decision context. Required on rejected (why not), approved (what was agreed, naming the operator and date) and dismissed (why the line is not a harness change); optional elsewhere.

into.description: merged only. The surviving proposal id this one was folded into.

commit.description: landed only. The commit that closed the proposal.
